sub_limits_waiting_notes: Standalone individual indemnity policy (SI Rs 1-10L). Reinstatement of Basic SI available for SI >= Rs 6L. Each member can have separate SI.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room up to 25% SI per illness (1% SI/day, max Rs 10,000/day); ICU 2% SI/day, max Rs 20,000/day
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Proportionate clause applies if room rent exceeds limit.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day care procedures (less than 24 hours hospitalisation)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: 1% of SI per period subject to max Rs. 2,000

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Reinstatement of Basic SI once per year (available for SI Rs 6L+)
restoration_benefit.notes: Reinstated SI applies to subsequent hospitalisations only; lapses if not used. Available only on SI >= Rs 6L.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Preventive Health Check Up at end of 4 continuous claim-free years

room_rent_capping: 1% of SI per day, max Rs. 10,000/day; total per illness 25% of SI
icu_capping: 2% of SI per day, max Rs. 20,000/day
copayment_trigger_notes: Optional: 10% co-pay for 12.5% discount OR 20% co-pay for 25% discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.medical_practitioners_fees: Up to 25% of SI per illness
disease_wise_sub_limits.other_expenses: Up to 50% of SI per illness
disease_wise_sub_limits.dialysis_chemo_radio: Up to 50% of SI or PPN package rate
disease_wise_sub_limits.modern_treatments: Up to 25% of SI per treatment

notable_exclusions_summary: Granular sub-limits: room/doctor fees/other expenses each capped at % of SI. Pre-hosp 45 days; post 60 days. Reinstatement of SI only for SI >= Rs 6L. Optional 10/20% copay for premium discount.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network/PPN with 1-hour pre-auth. Reimbursement within 30 days. 15-day claim decision; 45 if investigation.
